decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and spells, utilizing the synergy between spells like Monstrous Rage, Stock Up, and Stormchaser's Talent to pump up creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Drake Hatcher. The deck also includes efficient card draw and mana fixing tools like Opt and Riverpyre Verge to maintain a fast pace. Additionally, removal spells like Into the Flood Maw and Torch the Tower help to clear the way for your creatures to attack and deal damage.

The focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient spells in the colors of red and blue. By utilizing inexpensive threats like Monastery Swiftspear and Drake Hatcher, along with powerful instant and sorcery spells like Burst Lightning and Opt, this deck aims to apply early pressure and finish the game before the opponent can stabilize. With a low mana curve and a mix of burn spells and creatures, this deck aims to outpace the opponent and secure victory through aggression and efficient card choices.

This deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures and utilizing removal spells to control the board and pressure the opponent. It includes cards that disrupt the opponent's hand and mana base, while also providing ways to buff and protect your own creatures. With a combination of powerful threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Archfiend of the Dross, along with efficient removal options like Go for the Throat and Cut Down, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and maintain the upper hand throughout the game.

The main concept of this Mono Black Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disrupt their game plan with a mixture of removal spells like Go for the Throat and Duress. Utilizing cards like Rot-Curse Rakshasa and Preacher of the Schism to put pressure on the opponent, while also including cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Qarsi Revenant for additional power. The deck aims to control the board while dealing consistent damage to the opponent with a combination of creatures and spells.

The deck focuses on aggressive play with a mix of control elements, utilizing low-cost creatures and removal spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It also includes cards that provide card advantage and disruption to outpace the opponent. The deck is designed to maintain board presence and apply pressure throughout the game, while also having answers to threats from the opponent. The mana base is carefully balanced to ensure consistent and efficient casting of spells. Overall, the deck aims to establish dominance early and maintain it until victory is secured.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. The strategy is to control the board with removal spells like Go for the Throat and Duress, while also utilizing evasive creatures like Spyglass Siren and Deep-Cavern Bat to deal damage. The deck also includes powerful creatures like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to provide additional threats. With a mix of control and aggression, this Dimir Aggro deck looks to pressure the opponent and finish the game quickly.

The main concept of the deck is to utilize Omniscience to cast powerful spells for free, enabling explosive combos that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck includes cards like Marang River Regent and Roiling Dragonstorm to create a strong board presence and deal massive damage. Temporary Lockdown and Confounding Riddle provide control elements to disrupt the opponent's strategy, while Stock Up and Meticulous Archive help draw cards and find key pieces of the combo. Overall, the deck focuses on assembling the Omniscience Combo to secure victory.

The UR Aggro deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with cheap, aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Drake Hatcher, while utilizing burn spells like Burst Lightning and Torch the Tower to control the board and finish off the opponent. Card draw and selection through spells like Opt and Sleight of Hand help ensure the deck can maintain its momentum and find the needed resources to close out the game. The deck aims to apply constant pressure on the opponent and win the game before they can stabilize.

The main idea of this UW Control deck is to slow down the opponent's game plan by controlling the board with removal spells and counterspells while gradually building up card advantage through card draw and resource manipulation. The deck aims to outlast the opponent by grinding out value with its spells and eventually taking control of the game with powerful finishers. The deck's strategy revolves around creating a defensive shell that can eventually transition into a dominant position to close out the game.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and spells, utilizing cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Stock Up to deal damage quickly. The deck also includes card draw and spell recursion to maintain pressure on the opponent. By playing efficient threats and burning spells, the deck aims to close out the game before the opponent can stabilize. The focus is on creating a fast-paced, highly aggressive playstyle to win the game swiftly.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a blend of black and white creatures and spells. It aims to quickly build a board presence and apply pressure on the opponent using cards like Hopeless Nightmare, Preacher of the Schism, and Momentum Breaker. The inclusion of cards like Nowhere to Run and Temporary Lockdown further disrupts the opponent's strategy while maintaining the aggressive tempo. The deck also features some powerful Orzhov cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Beza, the Bounding Spring to provide additional threats and value. Good for players who enjoy quick and aggressive strategies.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly build a fast and aggressive board presence while utilizing spells like Burst Lightning and Monstrous Rage to control the board and push damage through. The key strategy is to apply early pressure with efficient creatures like Qarsi Revenant and Preacher of the Schism, while also using powerful finishers like Archfiend of the Dross and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The main concept of this Azorius Aggro deck is to establish board control and disrupt opponents with cards like Spyglass Siren and Mockingbird, while also utilizing cards like Raise the Past and Soulstone Sanctuary to provide resilience and recursion. The deck aims to consistently apply pressure with aggressive creatures like Regal Bunnicorn and Warden of the Inner Sky, utilizing Enduring Curiosity and Shardmage's Rescue to maintain card advantage and protect key threats. Overall, this deck focuses on a proactive strategy that combines aggression and disruption to overwhelm opponents and secure victory.
